IC1: Having significant medical illnesses that would interfere with the conduct of the study
IC3: Having comorbid psychiatric conditions according to the criteria set forth in the DSM-IV(administered by the Mini-International Neuropsychiatric Interview (MINI))
IC4: The current OCD symptoms are too severe that the patient cannot finish the evaluation or receive the ERP
IC5: Being currently at risk for suicide
IC6: Being pregnant or having the intention to be pregnant before the end of the study
IC7: A history of having inadequate response to adequate SSRIs or CB [OR]T treatment
IC8: Subjects who are unable to undergo the MRI
